test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boys Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Sonu and Monu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Monu is second to the left of Sonu. Sonu is second to the left of Rahul. Sahil is not the immediate neighbour of Sonu. Sahil is third to the right of Ram. Sohan is third to the right of Ramesh.

Who is third to the left of Rahul?
solution: Seven boys Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Sonu and Monu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 1) Monu is second to the left of Sonu. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72e0d251e1d1b477c68b141cb26db128a8a4a90f4479577fd50425d14a5d53cd.png] 2) Sonu is second to the left of Rahul.
